query:
SELECT DISTINCT target_country_code, target_country_name, COUNT(*) as count 
FROM investments 
WHERE target_country_name LIKE '%香港%' OR target_country_name LIKE '%Hong Kong%'
GROUP BY target_country_code, target_country_name
ORDER BY count DESC;
